mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT A.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, A.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, A.PROFIT_TYPE portfolioType FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO A LEFT JOIN PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO B ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = B.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bondCode, fp.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR bondAbbrName, fp.MDATE mdate,
fp.REGIST_ORG repRegistOrg, MBCR.GRADE_RESULT gradeResult, mbvi.LAST_PERIOD endDays1, ava.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId,
(NVL(ava.AMOUNT, 0) + nvl(AVA_FLOW.amount, 0)) * 100 prin, NVL(pledge.AMOUNT, 0) * 100 pledgePrin, NVL(pledge.AMOUNT, 0) * 100 pledgePrinInit, (NVL(ava.AMOUNT, 0) - NVL(pledge.AMOUNT, 0) + nvl(AVA_FLOW.amount, 0)) * 100 avaPledgePrin, mbvi.NETPRICE firstNetPrice,
/* edit by songyawei 2020/06/15 end */
fpt.type_6 secType
, CASE WHEN ava.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_AC} THEN 1 WHEN ava.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_FVOCI} THEN 2 WHEN ava.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_FVTPL} THEN 3 ELSE 0 END invAimSort, ava.INV_AIM invAim
FROM
(select PSP.FINPROD_ID,
INV_AIM,
SUM(DECODE(PSP.HODING_TYPE,#{POSITION_TYPE_06},-PSP.AMOUNT,'11',-PSP.AMOUNT,PSP.AMOUNT)) AMOUNT
SUM(DECODE(PSP.HODING_TYPE,#{POSITION_TYPE_06},-PSP.AMOUNT,'11',-PSP.AMOUNT,PSP.AMOUNT)) AMOUNT
, psp.SEC_ACCT_ID from PTL_SEC_POSITION PSP LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T ON PSP.FINPROD_ID = T.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FPSAI ON PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = FPSAI.FINPROD_ID WHERE T.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F01} and psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND psp.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{plateDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and PSP.HODING_TYPE IN (#{POSITION_TYPE_01}, #{POSITION_TYPE_03},#{POSITION_TYPE_06}, '11', '08')
and PSP.HODING_TYPE IN (#{POSITION_TYPE_01}, #{POSITION_TYPE_03},#{POSITION_TYPE_05},#{POSITION_TYPE_06}, '11', '08')
AND PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{chlId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (FPSAI.FINPROD_ID is null or FPSAI.FINPROD_TYPE2 !='F28')
and psp.cdate = (select max(cdate) from PTL_SEC_POSITION tt where tt.portfolio_id = psp.portfolio_id and tt.sec_acct_id = psp.sec_acct_id and tt.finprod_id = psp.finprod_id AND tt.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{plateDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and tt.branch = psp.branch and tt.inv_aim = psp.inv_aim and tt.hoding_type = psp.hoding_type and tt.ccy = psp.ccy ) GROUP BY psp.finprod_id, psp.SEC_ACCT_ID
,INV_AIM
)ava LEFT JOIN ( select sum(decode(PSP.HODING_TYPE, '12', -1*psp.AMOUNT, psp.amount)) AMOUNT, psp.finprod_id, psp.SEC_ACCT_ID
,INV_AIM
from PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW PSP INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T ON PSP.FINPROD_ID = T.FINPROD_ID AND T.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F01} and psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND psp.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{plateDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and PSP.HODING_TYPE IN (#{POSITION_TYPE_01}, '12')
AND PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{chlId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW PSP1 WHERE PSP1.portfolio_id = psp.portfolio_id and PSP1.sec_acct_id = psp.sec_acct_id and PSP1.finprod_id = psp.finprod_id AND PSP1.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{plateDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and PSP1.CDATE > psp.CDATE and PSP1.branch = psp.branch and PSP1.inv_aim = psp.inv_aim and PSP1.hoding_type = psp.hoding_type and PSP1.ccy = psp.ccy) group by PSP.finprod_id, psp.SEC_ACCT_ID
,INV_AIM
) AVA_FLOW ON ava.FINPROD_ID = AVA_FLOW.FINPROD_ID and ava.SEC_ACCT_ID = AVA_FLOW.SEC_ACCT_ID
AND ava.INV_AIM = AVA_FLOW.INV_AIM
INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T ON ava.FINPROD_ID = T.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY O_CODE ORDER BY GRADE_DATE DESC, DECODE(GRADE_ORG_ID,'02',NULL, GRADE_ORG_ID), grade_result DESC, O_TYPE) NUM, O_CODE, GRADE_RESULT FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING WHERE GRADE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{plateDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ) MBCR ON MBCR.O_CODE = T.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND MBCR.NUM = 1
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PSP.FINPROD_ID,
PSP.INV_AIM,
SUM(NVL(PSP.AMOUNT, 0)) AMOUNT, psp.SEC_ACCT_ID FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION PSP WHERE PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PSP.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{plateDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND PSP.HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE_04}
AND PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{chlId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION PSP1 WHERE PSP1.portfolio_id = psp.portfolio_id and PSP1.sec_acct_id = psp.sec_acct_id and PSP1.finprod_id = psp.finprod_id AND PSP1.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{plateDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and PSP1.CDATE > psp.CDATE and PSP1.branch = psp.branch and PSP1.inv_aim = psp.inv_aim and PSP1.hoding_type = psp.hoding_type and PSP1.ccy = psp.ccy) GROUP BY PSP.FINPROD_ID, psp.SEC_ACCT_ID
,INV_AIM
) pledge ON pledge.FINPROD_ID = ava.FINPROD_ID and pledge.SEC_ACCT_ID = ava.SEC_ACCT_ID
AND pledge.INV_AIM = ava.INV_AIM
INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = ava.FINPROD_ID
AND fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F01}
AND fp.TRADE_MARKET = #{tradeMarket}
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA ON FPA.FINPROD_ID = T.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO mbvi ON mbvi.SEC_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND mbvi.VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{plateDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO mbviInner WHERE mbviInner.SEC_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND mbviInner.VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{plateDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND mbviInner.VALUE_DATE > mbvi.VALUE_DATE ) AND mbvi.VALUE_SOURCE IN (SELECT BVSD.VALUATION_PRICE FROM bok_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL BVSD LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FBN ON FBN.TRADE_MARKET = BVSD.TRADE_MARKET WHERE FBN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND BVSD.VALUATION_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND BVSD.SCHEME_ID = 'SCHEME001')
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON fp.FINPROD_ID = FPT.FINPROD_ID
AND ava.AMOUNT >= 0 /*modify by caojin 2020/6/1 债券质押式回购 可质押券面总额全部质押时 为0 故加上‘=’ TISHKBS-594 start*/ AND NVL(ava.AMOUNT, 0) - NVL(pledge.AMOUNT, 0) + nvl(AVA_FLOW.amount, 0) >= 0 /*modify by caojin 2020/6/1 债券质押式回购 可质押券面总额全部质押时 为0 故加上‘=’ end*/ /*modify by mashukai 2021/4/15 过滤发行标的 start*/ AND (FPA.IS_ISSUE_ASSET IS NULL OR FPA.IS_ISSUE_ASSET = 'N') /*modify by mashukai 2021/4/15 过滤发行标的 end*/
AND fp.REGIST_ORG in
#{item}
AND fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{bondCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND FPT.TYPE_4 in
#{item, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND mbvi.LAST_PERIOD >= to_number(#{endDays1Start})
AND mbvi.LAST_PERIOD <= to_number(#{endDays1End})
AND fp.mdate >= to_date(#{mdate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ava.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_AC} THEN 1 WHEN ava.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_FVOCI} THEN 2 WHEN ava.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_FVTPL} THEN 3 ELSE 0 END

SELECT t.finprod_id finprodId, t.inv_aim invAim, sum(t.amount) * 100 avaPledgePrin, CASE WHEN t.inv_aim = #{INV_AIM_AC} THEN 1 WHEN t.inv_aim = #{INV_AIM_FVOCI} THEN 2 WHEN t.inv_aim = #{INV_AIM_FVTPL} THEN 3 ELSE 0 END invAimSort, t.inv_aim invAim FROM ptl_sec_position_flow t WHERE t.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.CDATE<= TO_DATE(#{plateDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and t.sec_acct_id=#{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.hoding_type= #{POSITION_TYPE_04} GROUP BY t.finprod_id,t.inv_aim

select B.SEC_ACCT_ID from PTL_SEC_ACCT A inner join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO B on A.ACCT_NO=B.SEC_ACCT_ID AND B.Sec_Acct_Type='SEC' where A.Portfolio_Id=#{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and exists (select 1 from fin_product p where finprod_type2='F01' and p.trade_market=B.TRADE_PLACE and p.regist_org=B.REGIST_ORG and p.finprod_id=#{finprodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
select FINPROD_ID from ETR_ENTRUST_PLEDGE where PLEDGE_STOCK_ID = #{pledgeStockId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
